site_ui.lead: Field-tested playbooks from unclaimed property practitioners on searching state and federal databases, launching a registered recovery business, tracing owners and heirs, and closing claims under state fee caps.
site_ui.summary: All 12 chapters synthesize 192 verbatim YouTube practitioner testimonies, each quoted with timestamped inline attribution to its source video. Coverage runs from search entry points and state claim filing through skip tracing, prospect outreach, fee collection, bankruptcy funds, and holder compliance.

flow: Pull the state's registration requirements, fee cap, agreement form, and claim-package instructions before dialing, and call the state office if anything is unclear.
Pick one niche and one or two states, download or buy state lists, and filter for big claims, holding a $10,000 floor under a 10% cap.
Start at MissingMoney.com, then unclaimed.org state portals, then federal registries for wages, pensions, FHA refunds, failed banks, and bankruptcy courts.
Locate owners and heirs for free or through batch skip tracing at about $14 to $15 per 100 leads instead of hours of manual research.
Prospect daily in a roughly three-hour block, weekends included, and commit to three to five follow-up calls per prospect.
Sign notarized agreements, file the claim package, and collect the capped fee only after the claimant is paid, with states like California paying the locator directly.
